data.title: The Cube Residences
data.about:
The Cube Residences by Amwaj Development, located in the vibrant Meydan – District 11, is a modern low-rise building offering an exclusive collection of 54 fully furnished units. Designed for convenience and sophistication, the building structure includes Basement + Ground + 5 Floors + Rooftop (B+G+5+R). The project offers 48 one-bedroom units and 6 two-bedroom units, catering to both individuals and families seeking contemporary living in one of Dubai’s most dynamic neighborhoods.

Each unit comes with a fully fitted kitchen and smart home technology to enhance daily living. Residents enjoy access to exceptional amenities, including a co-working space, lounge, and concierge reception desk on the ground floor, along with 24/7 security. The rooftop amenities include a pool, fitness club, sauna with showers, and a gaming room, making it an ideal choice for those seeking a balanced lifestyle of work, leisure, and wellness.

characteristics_module.title: Smart Living Meets Luxury Comfort at The Cube Residences
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Fully Furnished Units: Move-in ready with elegant interiors.
  • Smart Home Technology: Automated systems for enhanced convenience.
  • Ground Floor Amenities: Co-working space, lounge with coffee cart, concierge services, and 24/7 security.
  • Rooftop Amenities: Pool, fitness club, sauna with showers, and a gaming room.
  • Exclusive Location: Nestled in Meydan’s District 11, providing easy access to key Dubai landmarks.

image.name: The Cube Residences by Amwaj Development

location_tile.title: Experience Exceptional Connectivity and Family Friendly Living
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
The Cube Residences is situated in the prestigious Meydan District 11, an area renowned for its blend of luxury, lifestyle, and accessibility. Nestled within one of Dubai’s most dynamic neighborhoods, the development offers residents a peaceful yet connected living experience. Its strategic location ensures easy access to key landmarks, including Downtown Dubai, Meydan One Mall, and Dubai International Airport. With seamless connectivity to major business hubs and entertainment destinations, The Cube Residences offers the perfect balance between urban convenience and tranquil living.

10 minutes to Downtown Dubai
15 minutes to Dubai International Airport
5 minutes to Meydan One Mall
20 minutes to Dubai Marina
